cohort: The cohort consists of nulliparous and multiparous pregnant women diagnosed with idiopathic polyhydramnios at 24-28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Uterocervical angle measurement and cervical length were found to be successful predictors of spontaneous preterm labor risk in singleton pregnancies with idiopathic polyhydramnios, with preterm labor subjects exhibiting larger UCA values and smaller cervical length values.
gest_age: 24-28 weeks at diagnosis; outcomes defined as before 37 weeks (preterm) or at/after 37 weeks (term).
